name: Secret Recipe

gist.Zamorin, the Spice Rajah: Each Secret Spice in his deck counts double towards the potions it lets him run.
gist.Secret Red Spice: A blank card whose presence in the deck allows Acid Vials and Healing Potions in the main deck.
gist.Secret Blue Spice: Blank; allows Elixir of Quickness and Poison Vial.
gist.Secret Golden Spice: Blank; allows Elixir of Immortality and Magnetic Potion.
gist.Nicolas, the Hidden Alchemist: Cheap draws from the Potion Deck; at most two potions a turn.
gist.Bottled Lightning: A discard duel; the loser's side takes three hits.
gist.Bottled Flame: A discard duel; the loser's side burns.
gist.Potion Juggler: Plays potions off the top of the Potion Deck.
gist.Philosopher's Stone: Turns a potion draw into a search.
gist.Elixir of Immortality: Placed openly: the next target of his that falls stands back up.

plan: Rafa cooks with potions, far more of them than the rules normally allow, because the Secret Spices in his deck permit them. So he draws potions from two decks at once and plays two a turn: vials, bottled duels, heals. The price is ten spice cards that do nothing in his hand, and a deck with no engine beyond the next bottle. Potions are used once and deleted.

looks.early: Alchemy on three heroes, a spice card held like a dead fish.
looks.mid: Two potions a turn, a Juggler flipping more.
looks.late: An Elixir of Immortality on the table and a thin Potion Deck.

opening.tell: He is buying potions with gold and holding blank spice cards.
opening.why: He is slow and half his draws are blanks; nothing he has stops Ability attachments.

midgame.tell: Bottled Lightning: he starts discarding spices and waits for you.
midgame.why: His blanks win him discard duels for free: stop at once, take the hits on your sturdiest heroes, and keep your real cards.

crisis.tell: A Potion Juggler flips two potions a turn off the Potion Deck.
crisis.why: The Juggler and Nicolas are the supply: steal one, freeze the other.

endgame.tell: An Elixir of Immortality stands openly on his side and a Barkeeper is his only creature.
endgame.why: It saves the next target that falls: kill the Barkeeper first, then the hero.

opening.board: Rafa pays for a potion and shows you a Secret Red Spice with a shrug.
A Barkeeper hands him a fistful of Beer.
A Poison Vial on your caster.

midgame.board: Bottled Lightning: he discards a spice and looks at you.

options.text: Stop; take it on the sturdy heroes

crisis.board: The Juggler flips two potions a turn.
Philosopher's Stone searches the Potion Deck.
His own Flashbang ends your turn early.

options.text: Kill the alchemist who drew it

endgame.board: Elixir of Immortality out; one Barkeeper.

options.text: Kill Zamorin and watch him rise
